latest_release.name: v1.1.0
latest_release.body: ### Release Notes * **Fix:** Addressed several known issues and improved overall stability. * **Feat:** Introduced the new `noi` CLI command, enabling you to control Noi via command-line tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. More commands will be added over time to expand automation and control capabilities.

detail.readme:
🚀 Less chaos. More flow.

> [!TIP] > **Noi**: *`/nɔɪ/`* (sounds like "noy") [![Noi downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/lencx/Noi/total.svg?style=flat)](https://github.com/lencx/Noi/releases) [![Noi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Noi-discord-blue?style=flat&logo=discord&logoColor=f2f0ea)](https://discord.gg/kq2HXcpJSQ) ### Features * **Interaction-first workflow refresh** for a tighter, more focused browsing loop * **Multi-window management** to run parallel workspaces side by side * **Session isolation** to keep contexts clean, separated, and predictable * **Local-first data**: history, prompts, and settings stay on-device * **Prompt management for AI chats**: organize, reuse, and iterate on workflows * **Built-in terminal** for fast local commands, scripts, and tooling * **`noi` CLI command**: control Noi from tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI (more commands coming) * **Multiple themes & visual styles** to fit different setups and vibes * ... [Download...](https://github.com/lencx/Noi/releases/tag/v1.1.0) ## 中国用户 国内用户如果遇到使用问题或者想交流 Noi，可以关注公众号「**浮之静**」，发送 “**noi**” 进群参与讨论。如果 Noi 应用对你有帮助可以分享给更多人，或者微信扫码打赏。
